# Dr. Dhanshree's Dental Clinic

> Dental clinic in Lohegaon, Pune, India. Painless root canal treatment, dental
> implants, braces & clear aligners, teeth whitening, smile design, and cosmetic
> dentistry. Founded and led by Dr. Dhanshree Sanap (Ghuge). Open every day,
> 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM IST, including Sundays. 5.0 rating on Google.

Address: Shop No. 2, Muktai Plaza, Wadgaon Shinde Road, Opposite Eastern Royale
Society, Pathare Wasti, Lohegaon, Pune, Maharashtra 411047, India.
Phone: +91 82751 72931 (calls and WhatsApp bookings).
Email: dr.dhanshreedentalclinic@gmail.com
Serves: Lohegaon, Pathare Wasti, Wadgaon Shinde Road, Dhanori, Vishrantwadi,
Viman Nagar, and greater Pune.

## Booking

Appointments are booked via WhatsApp (+91 82751 72931) or phone. Same-day slots
are often available, and the clinic keeps room for patients in acute dental pain.
Cost estimates are provided in writing after examination, before treatment begins.
